name: race-condition-walkthrough
description: Guided walkthrough for the payment service race-condition lab

walkthroughs.title: Incident #1842: Race Condition
walkthroughs.description: A step-by-step guide to finding and fixing the payment service bug.

steps.title: 1. Read the incident report
steps.description:
Every incident starts with the report: symptoms, the task, and hints if you get stuck.
[Open README.md](command:raceLab.openReadme)

steps.title: 2. Reproduce the bug
steps.description:
Run the test suite. One test passes sequentially, the other fails under concurrency — that's the bug.
[Run pytest in terminal](command:raceLab.runTests)

steps.title: 3. Find the race condition
steps.description:
Open the file with the bug and read the `withdraw()` method carefully.
[Open account.py](command:raceLab.openAccountFile)

steps.title: 4. Apply the fix
steps.description: The check and the update need to happen as one atomic step. The lock for this already exists on the class — it's just never acquired in `withdraw()`.

steps.title: 5. Confirm the fix
steps.description:
Re-run the tests. Both should pass now.
[Run pytest in terminal](command:raceLab.runTests)

steps.title: 6. Optional: try the live dashboard
steps.description:
Start the API and open the forwarded port to reproduce the bug visually with concurrent requests.
[Start the server](command:raceLab.runServer)
